library_empty_text: Take a photo of a coloring page, or pick one from your gallery. Then tap areas to fill them with your pens.
imported_editable: Opened the saved page, ready to edit
delete_page_text: "{name}" and its colors are removed from this device.
prepare_crop_hint: Drag the corners onto the page corners. Tilted photos get straightened.
prepare_lost: The photo is gone after reloading. Please pick it again.
clear_all_text: Every filled area goes back to white. You can undo this.
export_legend: List of pens below the page
export_editable_hint: The PNG keeps your page editable: import it again to continue coloring.
settings_data_hint: Colors are approximations sampled from the makers' color charts. Real ink and pencil look different on paper, so swatch your pens to be sure.
settings_privacy: No account, no server. Your photos and pages stay on this device.
mode_lines_hint: Clean black outlines on white. Shadows and colors are removed.
mode_gray_hint: The photo in gray, otherwise unchanged.
mode_original_hint: The photo as it is, with its colors.
areas_hint: Each color is one area. Two areas in one color: close more gaps. An area split in parts: detect fewer lines.
no_pens_yet: Choose the pens you own first. Only those appear here, sorted by color.
my_pens_settings_hint: Choose the pens you own: whole sets or single pens, from any brand. The pen picker shows only these, sorted by color.
my_pens_row_hint: The pen picker shows only the pens you own.
sets_hint: Tap a set to add all its pens. Tap it again to remove them.
chart_hint: Print it and color each box with the real pen to see its true color.
